title: Studio: a draft autosave names nothing — only the top bar's "Saved HH:MM" shows, which the write-feedback convention does not count (ruling on #28345)
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbWJDYbbtH6dhJNoboN

立卡门: ① 产品缺陷（用户可见体验缺陷），具名落点 + 复现（reach: 界面，Studio 改字段标签后自动保存，实测两次）
业务理由: 在 Studio 里改元数据的管理员看不到「刚刚保存了什么」：自动保存落地后界面上只有顶栏的「已保存 时:分」，没有点名字段或对象的反馈。维护者在 #28345 的裁决 ② 定了：顶栏保存状态不算写入反馈，只有点名对象的 toast 或行内文字算。照此 ux-conventions.write-feedback 的 Studio 自动保存一行判失败，发版清单持续红；同屏连续改几个字段时，用户也无从确认哪一次落地了。
动手的读者: domain:ui 席，`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 的草稿自动保存路径（约 L8855「the hint is the whole affordance」处），让落地的保存点名所改条目（字段或对象标签），形态可选 toast 或行内状态。
查重: `studio autosave feedback names item` 11 命中、`studio saved indicator write feedback` 4（均含已关）；只有运行记录 #27441/#24570/#23953 和已关的裁决卡 #28345，没有产品卡。

QA-source: #28981 · ux-conventions.write-feedback · A0, A1

## What happens
A Studio draft autosave lands (`PUT … ?mode=draft` 200), but the only feedback is the top bar's "Saved HH:MM" (`data-testid=data-saved-at`), the "Draft · 1 unpublished" chip and the "Changes 1" counter. No toast and no role=status/alert text appears, and nothing names the field or the object.

Ruling 6545938831 ② on #28345 (2026-10-31): the Studio top-bar 「已保存」 is not write feedback; only record-naming feedback counts, and the convention's wording stands. Checklist item `ux-conventions.write-feedback` revision 9 scores that. The other Studio rows already comply: publish says "Published 1 item in this package", discard says "Draft discarded: QA Widget".

Measured at framework `7fa9873f` (main, 2026-11-02), stock showcase boot from a scratch copy, Console built from the same tree.

## Reproduction
1. As admin: `POST /api/v1/packages {"manifest":{"id":"com.qa.r6wf","name":"QA R6 Scratch","version":"0.1.0","type":"app","namespace":"qrsix"}}`, then `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qrsix_widget?package=com.qa.r6wf` with `sharingModel: "private"` and text fields `name` ("Name") and `note` ("Note").
2. Form sign-in; open `/_console/studio/com.qa.r6wf/data?surface=object:qrsix_widget` → Form → field "Note" → Properties → Label "QA Remark", Tab.
3. Network: `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qrsix_widget?mode=draft&package=com.qa.r6wf&surface=studio` → 200 `state: "draft"`.
4. **Expected:** a toast or inline text naming the item, e.g. the field "QA Remark" or the object "QA Widget".
5. **Actual:** zero toasts and no status/alert text over 6 s; only "Saved HH:MM", the Draft chip and the Changes counter. Reproduced twice (Note → QA Remark; Name → Widget Name).
